summary: Pre-existing duplicate last_name values (e.g., 'Cook') in account_user prevent adding a UNIQUE constraint without violating the rule that existing last_name values must not change. Both migration: apply (causes IntegrityError on deploy_new) and migration: state_only (causes UNIQUE violation checks during overlap) fail the runner's deterministic checks.
write_consistency: N/A – change cannot be rolled out safely.
revision_notes: Root cause: duplicate last_name values exist in the database; they cannot be altered per rollout rules, making the constraint addition impossible.

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version from traffic; after this only the new version operates.
